notes: Detector upgraded to V18, retrained against AI writing rewritten to sound human — the style that slipped past the old detector. On a held-out set of humanized essays in styles it never trained on, detection rose from 0% to 61%, and the false-flag rate on human writing fell to 4.8% (from 6.0%). Overall held-out accuracy 86.2%.

Honest trade-off: GPT-5 detection eased to 86.8% and one older paraphrase set dipped, so daily training keeps pushing on those next. A score is a signal to review — never proof of who wrote something.
